sectors.trend: Oil at $108 on Houthi pipeline strikes; diesel at record $6/gal; but IEA warns structural demand decline from EVs
sectors.implications: Short-term supply shock inflates energy costs; long-term EV transition (China 70% target) caps upside. Energy equities volatile but structurally challenged.

sectors.trend: Oracle jumps on AI buildout earnings; Anthropic/OpenAI security concerns; eCloudvalley sees AI boosting Taiwan cloud demand; Kalshi launches AI-linked perpetual futures
sectors.implications: AI capex cycle intact but security risks (Houthis using Anthropic AI, OpenAI malware) create regulatory overhang. Selective strength in infrastructure plays.

sectors.trend: HDFC Bank CEO succession; SEBI auction reform; Bessent yield intervention backfired; bond yields elevated; CD rates at 4.35% APY
sectors.implications: Rising rates pressure equity valuations but boost net interest margins. Regulatory shifts in India (SEBI) create near-term uncertainty.

sectors.trend: Diesel costs squeezing logistics; RH expanding market; Tijuana Flats franchise push; auto-parts makers hit by US-Canada trade war
sectors.implications: Margin compression across supply chains; consumer discretionary under pressure from input costs. Trade war adds tariff headwinds.

sectors.trend: Copper shortage flagged by Friedland; silver turning negative pre-CPI; gold at 1-month low
sectors.implications: Copper scarcity supports industrial/energy transition plays. Precious metals weak short-term but inflation hedge thesis intact.

sectors.trend: BRICS Summit signals multipolar coordination; Russia pivoting grain exports to Far East; UAE retakes VC crown; India regulatory reforms
sectors.implications: Geopolitical realignment may fragment trade flows. India remains net positive on reform momentum.

key_themes: Inflation reacceleration and Fed hawkish pivot risk
Geopolitical supply disruption (Houthis, Black Sea, Saudi pipeline)
Structural energy transition vs. short-term oil shock
AI capex boom with emerging security/regulatory risks
Rising rates crushing mortgage/real estate affordability
Fiscal policy uncertainty (Trump $5K checks, Treasury buyback failure)
9/11 remembrance and NYC financial district resilience narrative
Crypto volatility (BTC <$77K, XRP skepticism, Kalshi perpetuals)

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration exposure; favor short-duration bonds and inflation-linked assets (TIPS). Hedge equity with put spreads.
Overweight energy hedges; monitor Brent/WTI spreads. Diversify away from logistics-heavy equities.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mortgage rate spike / housing affordability crisis
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid long-duration real estate exposure; favor REITs with floating-rate debt. Lock in fixed-rate mortgages if refinancing.
Monitor AI governance legislation; favor established AI infra (Oracle, NVDA) over speculative AI startups.
Reduce exposure to auto-parts and cross-border supply chain names. Favor domestic-manufacturing plays.
Watch for bond market reaction to fiscal expansion signals. Maintain cash buffer.
Favor companies with strong cyber posture; avoid names with recent breach exposure.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy hedges and oil-linked ETFs short-term
opportunities.rationale: Houthi strikes + $108 oil create 3-6 month supply premium; diesel at record supports energy margins

opportunities.recommendation: Add copper and industrial metals exposure
opportunities.rationale: Monumental copper shortage (Friedland) + energy transition demand creates structural supply gap

opportunities.recommendation: Selective AI infrastructure plays post-Oracle earnings
opportunities.rationale: Oracle jump validates AI capex cycle; eCloudvalley confirms Taiwan cloud demand; favor infra over application layer
SEBI auction reform + HDFC CEO succession + Tata stake sale signal capital market deepening

opportunities.recommendation: TIPS and short-duration bonds as inflation hedge
opportunities.rationale: CPI reacceleration + Fed hike risk makes nominal bonds risky; TIPS preserve real yield

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce long-duration equity and bond exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising yields + inflation fears create headwind for duration; Bessent backfire shows policy incoherence risk
$6 diesel + trade war tariffs compress margins across supply chains
Elevated CD rates (4.35% APY) offer risk-free yield; uncertainty around CPI/Fed warrants dry powder

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge with gold despite short-term weakness
defensive_moves.rationale: Gold at 1-month low is contrarian entry; inflation + geopolitical risk + BRICS de-dollarization support medium-term thesis

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid speculative crypto and perpetual futures
defensive_moves.rationale: BTC below $77K, XRP skepticism, Kalshi leveraged bets amplify risk; security concerns (OpenAI malware) add regulatory risk

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. CPI reacceleration + Fed hike risk + oil shock create headwinds. Expect volatility spike. S&P futures edging higher on oil retreat but fragile. Bond yields elevated. Equity outflows continue. 2-3 week window of elevated VIX.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle, copper/energy transition, India reforms, and BRICS trade integration support 6-12 month growth. But structural oil demand decline (IEA 'lost period') and EV transition cap energy upside. Inflation regime shift may keep rates elevated through 2027.

Fed FOMC reaction to inflation data
watch_list: US CPI (August) - core vs. headline divergence
